name: Event Hubs namespace
summary: High-throughput event streaming platform for telemetry, logs and data pipelines, with partitions, consumer groups and Kafka support.
useWhen: You need to ingest millions of events per second from many producers
You need a Kafka-compatible endpoint or streaming input for Stream Analytics and Spark
avoidWhen: You need per-message settlement, sessions or dead-lettering (use Service Bus)
You need lightweight reactive event routing (use Event Grid)
